caption: The drawing shows a wooden chest of drawers with a drop-front writing desk, rendered in shades of brown, with visible wood grain patterns in a realistic style. The chest is composed of three wide lower drawers, each fitted with two brass handles, and supported by four carved cabriole legs that end in ball-and-claw feet. The top section of the chest includes a hinged writing surface that is shown open and supported by two pull-out arms on either side. Inside the open compartment, there are several small drawers and pigeonholes, symmetrically arranged, with brass knobs on each drawer and intricate decorative fretwork on two vertical cabinet doors in the center. The background is plain, with a beige tone, and a faint outlined border framing the composition.
title: Desk
